title: Regent Admission Index Calculator
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Run the University of Iowa's Regent Admission Index formula and see how GPA, ACT score, core courses, and residency decide whether you clear the admission threshold.

learningObjectives: Students will use the Regent Admission Index formula to calculate a score from GPA, ACT, and core-course years and determine whether it meets the resident and nonresident thresholds.

keyQuestions: A full GPA point is worth 30 RAI points and an ACT point is worth 3. What does that weighting say about what Iowa values?
Why can one more year of a core course matter as much as almost two ACT points?
How does Iowa review an applicant who doesn't submit a test score?
commonMisconceptions: Test-optional means the formula ignores the ACT; in fact applicants without scores are reviewed individually.
The same score means the same outcome for every applicant regardless of residency.
assessmentOpportunities: Students calculate an RAI by hand from three inputs and state whether it clears the resident and nonresident thresholds.
